description: Group health plans do not ensure plan sponsor implements required safeguards.
applicability: This signal applies to: Covered entities and business associates Healthcare organizations with business associate relationships Group health plans and plan sponsors Organizations requiring HIPAA compliance documentation Vendor management and contract administration functions

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: For group health plans, review plan documents to confirm they include provisions restricting plan sponsor access to ePHI and requiring appropriate safeguards. Verify that plan sponsors have implemented security measures and incident reporting procedures. Assess whether plan amendments have been executed to incorporate required Security Rule provisions.
